newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine peso ends unchanged in range trading.
newsitem.headline: Philippine peso ends unchanged in range trading.

text.p: The Philippine peso closed unchanged on Wednesday at 26.245 pesos in narrow-range trading, traders said.
"The market was in equilibrium," a dealer from a large commercial bank said.
Though banks were selling their dollars due to the higher overnight rates at the money market, these were being met by buyers to meet the commercial demand of clients, he said.

The day's average, however, yielded a stronger peso to the dollar at 26.241 versus 26.244 on Tuesday due to a block sale of $50 million to the Central Bank which bought these at 26.237 pesos, traders said.
The peso traded in the range of 26.246 to 26.237.
Market volume swelled to $131.40 million from $84.20 million.
Dealers say Thursday could see a stronger peso as banks exchange their dollars for pesos due to the interest rate premium the peso carries over the weekend.
